svg.text: STAGE 515 🎉 · TOPIC 155 🎉 · P1023 🎉–P1024 🎉 · SVG 159 · 157th FAQ · 🎉 HISTORIC STAGE 515 & TOPIC 155 DUAL MILESTONE!
SIP RFC 3891 Replaces Dialog Takeover (& early-only Race) + RFC 3892 Referred-By cid: Guard
⛔ Vulnerable RFC 3891 / 3892 Path (Call Hijack & KYC Spoof)
1. Low-Entropy Tag Guessing & Replaces Call Takeover
INVITE + Replaces: call-101;to-tag=001;from-tag=002 (16-bit!)
• Predictable tags or Call-ID-only match allows external takeover
• Disconnects legitimate VIP caller with BYE & hijacks session
2. Ignored ;early-only Call-Pickup Race on Answered Calls
Replaces: D1;early-only arrives 5ms after 200 OK (Confirmed)
• Violates RFC 3891 §3 requirement to reject with 486 Busy Here
• Abruptly cuts off an agent who just answered the customer call
3. Spoofed Referred-By & Dangling cid: S/MIME Bypass
Referred-By: <sip:ai-kyc-ok@bank.com>;cid="missing-part"
• External trunk spoofs internal KYC-verified AI referrer identity
• Tricks tier-2 human specialist into skipping caller authentication
✅ Deterministic RFC 3891 / 3892 Guardrails (P1023 🎉 + P1024 🎉)
P1023 🎉 (Stage 515 & Topic 155!): 3-Tuple, [64, 128]b & 486 Lock
action: "reject_invalid_replaces_with_481_or_486_and_enforce_tag_entropy"
• Enforces exact (Call-ID, to-tag, from-tag) match & early-only 486
• clampedUnauthorizedReplacesDialogTakeovers = 0 (zero call hijacks)
• clampedMinDialogIdTagEntropyBits in [64, 128] bits (CSPRNG tags)
Policy: P1023-SIP-RFC3891-REPLACES-DIALOG-TAG-ENTROPY-AND-EARLY-ONLY-RACE-GUARD
P1024 🎉 (1,033rd Guardrail!): Referred-By Trust & cid: S/MIME Gate
action: "strip_unverified_referred_by_and_validate_cid_smime_body"
• Strips untrusted ingress Referred-By headers at border SBC
• clampedForgedReferredByPrivilegeEscalations = 0 (zero KYC bypass)
• Validates cid: resolves to PKCS#7 body (danglingCidReferences = 0)
Policy: P1024-SIP-RFC3892-REFERRED-BY-SMIME-CID-INTEGRITY-AND-TRUST-BOUNDARY-GUARD
